question_text: Under Article XIII of the 1987 Constitution, the State is mandated to protect the rights of workers and promote agrarian reform. Which of the following scenarios best illustrates the State's compliance with this mandate?

options.text: The government implements a law that allows landowners to retain up to 10 hectares of agricultural land, regardless of the number of tenants.
The Department of Labor and Employment issues a regulation requiring all companies to provide a minimum wage and overtime pay.
The Congress passes a law that prohibits workers from forming unions in industries considered vital to national security.
The President issues an executive order that exempts agricultural cooperatives from paying taxes.
